q: Heat is the amount of energy transferred from one object to another because of a difference in ____.
e: Heat is energy transferred because of a temperature difference. Heat is the amount of energy transferred from one object to another because of a difference in temperature.

q: As heat is a form of energy, heat can be measured in energy ____.
e: Heat is energy flowing because of a temperature difference. SI unit is the joule. As heat is a form of energy, heat can be measured in energy unit.

q: The unit of heat is joule (J) in ____ unit.
e: Heat is energy, so the SI unit is the joule. The unit of heat is joule (J) in SI unit.

q: Other heat units are calorie (cal) in the ____ system and kilocalorie (kcal) in the MKS system.
e: One kilocalorie raises 1 kg of water by 1 K. That is the MKS heat unit. Other heat units are calorie (cal) in the CGS system and kilocalorie (kcal) in the MKS system.

q: The heat unit in British system is the ____.
e: Heat is energy flowing because of a temperature difference. SI unit is the joule. The heat unit in British system is the British thermal unit(Btu).

q: Heat required to change the temperature of 1 kilogram mass of water by 1kelvin is called 1 ____.
e: One kilocalorie raises 1 kg of water by 1 K. That is the MKS heat unit. Heat required to change the temperature of 1 kilogram mass of water by 1kelvin is called 1 kilocalorie.
